lead_independence.headline: Martin County seeks to revive drainage project as Trailside flooding threatens cattle
lead_independence.lead: Martin County plans to revive a previously unbuilt drainage project as flooding continues to cover Trailside pastures. High water still prevents crews from reaching the berm breach that sent water toward the community.

lead_independence.lead: A neighboring pond overflowed onto the cemetery grounds during last week’s heavy rain. A family fears further flooding could cause caskets to float.

lead_independence.headline: SUV turned into motorcycle’s path in fatal Indian River County crash, FHP says
lead_independence.lead: The Florida Highway Patrol says an SUV turned left into the path of a motorcycle during Monday’s fatal crash on 37th Street. The motorcyclist, a 58-year-old man, died at a hospital, and the SUV driver suffered minor injuries.
